stackDivergence.rationale: Task78 implements original mdds3.2.1 multi_type_matrix core geometry/storage/access over the genuine existing SoA vector. Original trait registration, size_pair_type, default/size/value/range/copy/defaulted move and assignments/destructor, equality, plain/hinted/const positions, typed scalar and owned reads, borrowed string queries, scalar/range/column/empty writes, numeric/empty/clear/swap retain original contracts. Erased template aliases/value categories use explicit witnesses; numeric conversion is certified only for initialized representable native casts and exact bounded size_t coordinates. Ordinary full unchanged matrix/vector headers and genuine SharedString dependencies provide whole native streams; Calc custom string/UInt16/UInt8 traits are source excerpts, not fake pointees. Transpose, matrix copy/resize/block walks, ScMatrix/ScFormulaResult/formula cells/column/table/document/edit/undo/input/view/UI, native ABI/invalid lifetimes/concurrency/full upstream QA remain required or unverified. Foundation and broad parity flags remain false; next full81.
